item.title: SearXNG running on OpenBSD on a ThinkPad t420
item.summary: My dad gave me his old T420 thinkpad and as any person who finds an old thinkpad i put ubuntu on it then found that the bios chip has more controller of my laptop then me so i Librebooted it with CH341A and installed OpenBSD btw and now it hosts SearXNG on it and bought the domain opensear dot ch and exposed it to the internet this is probably the most stupidest thing i did so far Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49390153 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
